name: Faulted Loader
flavor: A retired cargo loader with a split relay and no safety governor. Its motor repeats a three-beat fault: two armored cycles, then one exposed electrical opening.
description: Workshop loader with an exposed Shock weakness. Hit the relay to reduce active cooldowns and bring abilities back sooner.

name: Echo-Borer
flavor: A subterranean skitterer with crystalline digging claws. It tracks footfall through the rock, burrows below the tunnel floor, and strikes from loose ground. Its claws crystallize as they cool, and a chilled borer cannot grip stone.
description: Burrows, then attacks from below. Insulated against Shock. Burn opens it up; Freeze locks its claws and keeps it above ground. Often yields Beast Meat for cooking or Source Resin crafting.

name: Siren Skimmer
flavor: Hovering cave pests nest around geothermal vents. Their throat sacs hold pressurized steam for a shriek that overloads suit optics and balance sensors. The sac only works hot.
description: Fast airborne controller. Its shriek briefly disrupts suit optics. Too quick to reliably shoot, but Freeze collapses the steam sac and drops it. May yield venom for crafting Antidote Flasks and rations for recovery.

name: Dominion Dampener
flavor: Corporate security troopers wear sealed helmets against drill noise and mine gas. Their rifles pin workers behind cover while flashbangs disrupt an organized push. The seals that keep the gas out also keep a charge in.
description: Uses suppressive fire and flashbangs. Acid eats the helmet seal and Burn gets underneath it; Shock carries well through sealed gear.

name: Acoustic Bulwark
flavor: A Dominion riot enforcer braces behind a powered acoustic shield. Break its Guard to expose the armor beneath.
description: Armored Dominion opponent with an active barrier. Hydraulic Kick breaks its Guard; Stagger disrupts the shield. May yield Armor Plate; salvage it in the Field Kit for Scrap Metal and Ballistic Weave.

name: Resonance Buoy
flavor: A floating survey drone maps tunnel pressure with timed pings. Security uses the same transmitter to mark disturbances for backup teams. Every ping it finishes brings someone else down the tunnel.
description: Fast support drone with EMP and Static bursts. It calls in whatever else is nearby, so it dies first. Shock drops it in one; its casing shrugs off Acid. May yield wiring and batteries for Field Kit repairs, lures, and Pulse Grenades.

name: Pressure Hauler
flavor: A massive mining loader built for high-pressure depths. Its overloaded hydraulics heat the frame, and each step drives loose rock from the shoring.
description: Heavy mechanized loader that retaliates with hydraulic slam and venting steam. Its dense chassis shrugs off physical impacts and fire; corrode its casing with Acid or short out its drive system with Shock.

name: The Iron Warden
flavor: The Sector Commander advances behind a powered riot shield. His gun locks onto its target before each burst. Below the failing shield, sealed armor vents betray an emergency overclock.
description: Solo armored boss. Read the burst lock-on and gas preparation, defend or disrupt the attack, and strike during recovery. Emergency Overclock drops his shield.

name: Shard-Hound
flavor: A canine-like predator with crystalline shards jutting from its spine. It attacks fast and relies on pack tactics.
description: Marks its intended prey before pouncing, then repositions. Pack partners begin on different beats. Weak to fire.

name: Spore-Spitter
flavor: A bulbous, root-bound flora that spits toxic spore sacs at range. It thrives in high-moisture swamp zones.
description: Its swelling bulb announces a single-target spore release. Interrupt or Guard; fire remains effective. May yield venom for Antidote Flasks.

name: Ruin-Guardian
flavor: An ancient robotic sentinel designed to protect Sanctuary infrastructure. Its chassis is heavily armored and shielded.
description: Braces a stone ward once, announces its relic strike, then exposes its joints. Weak to Shock; basic attacks remain viable.

name: Razor-Vine
flavor: Overgrown predatory vines with needle-sharp thorns that react to heat and movement.
description: Coils a thorned tendril before weakening one target. A damaging hit interrupts the coil. Extremely weak to fire; guards useful herbs.

windups.sector9_coil: Tendril coiling — strike it to interrupt

name: Stalker-Vine
flavor: An elite biological plant organism that channels natural light and underground nutrients to heal itself and other flora.
description: Shelters the plant formation once and spends at most two healing reserves. Interrupt the rooting or pressure its partner; recovery cannot continue indefinitely.

windups.sector9_mend: Roots drawing from a finite reserve

name: Sentinel Orb
flavor: A hovering security globe patrolling the upper stasis corridors, firing concentrated resonance shocks at intruders.
description: Its iris opens before a targeted discharge. Strike during exposed recovery or interrupt the charge; insulated against Shock.

name: The Source Beast
flavor: A massive swamp predator warped by Source resonance. It studies a victim before committing its weight. Wounded, it abandons the patient hunt for a frantic two-strike rush that leaves its flanks exposed.
description: Solo apex predator. Marks prey before a heavy lunge. Below half health it announces two separately warned frenzy strikes, then overextends. Guard, interrupt, heal or attack during recovery.

name: Sewer Crawler
flavor: A fast, multi-legged sewer dweller that thrives in the toxic run-offs of the Spire. Its bite carries corrosive acid.
description: Corrosive sewage biological. Applies acid/erosion. May yield Wiring Bundles for Field Kit repairs and fishing lures.

name: Riot Guard
flavor: Dominion crowd control specialists armored in heavy composite plates. They carry high-voltage stun batons to enforce the curfew.
description: Braces the squad once, then warns before rushing a target with its baton.

name: Sentinel Mk. I
flavor: A specialized flying drone designed to monitor and quarantine the Lower City boundaries. It is shielded against electrical surges.
description: Flying Dominion robot shield droid. Drops Neon Sign Core. Carries the Neon Sign Core for Jax’s repair and may yield a Battery for Pulse Grenades.

name: Aero Drone
flavor: A polished aerial stun drone built to keep the Upper City peaceful by making dissent briefly unconscious.
description: Charges a targeted ion burst that weakens its target, then evades and repositions. Physical strikes work well.

name: Corporate Assassin
flavor: An executive problem-solver with a clean suit, quiet boots, and no paperwork.
description: Stealth critical striker that punishes blind attacks. Scan exposes its poor shock shielding before it can vanish again.

name: Heavy Mech
flavor: A luxury riot frame carrying enough heat to make a clean rooftop smell like slag.
description: Braces, warms up a wide heat sweep, then exposes its vents. Shock breaks its stabilizers fastest.

name: Administrator
flavor: The smiling intelligence that keeps the Upper City clean, calm, and terrified.
description: Warns before deploying an Interdictor or firing the Laser Lattice. Carries three reserve drones, with at most two escorts active. Below 35% HP it switches to exposed emergency fire. Shock is effective.

name: Magma Drone
flavor: A heat-shielded aerial harasser built to herd workers away from restricted slag channels.
description: Fast burn-element drone. Cooling and shock attacks destabilize it. May yield Wiring Bundles and Power Cells for Field Kit repairs.

name: Slag Golem
flavor: A furnace-bulk material hauler with slag hardened around its frame like living armor.
description: Slow armored hitter. After Molten Slam it spends a turn cooling with its shell exposed. Exploit that opening or use Freeze and Shock against its armor. May yield Scrap Metal and Power Cells for crafting and salvage.

name: Welder Bot
flavor: A close-range assembly bot whose safety governors were removed for productivity.
description: Repair support. Field Weld restores itself and its squad, but only twice per battle. Disable it or focus it down before attacking armored allies; between repairs it uses Torch Cut. May yield Scrap Metal and Power Cells. Check individual patrols for recoverable stock.

name: Flame Trooper
flavor: Armored Dominion infantry trained to clear factory uprisings without damaging the machinery.
description: Armored cone-AoE trooper. Source disruption weakens its suit locks. May yield healing supplies and Battery Packs. Salvage a Battery Pack for wiring.

name: Phantom
flavor: A fast, empty derivative of Gh0st built with better hardware and no self.
description: Stealth Source assassin. Scan and shock expose its timing. May yield Wiring Bundles and Power Cells for crafting.

name: Conveyor Crusher
flavor: An industrial press that does not know you are alive and would not care if it did.
description: The press rises, commits to a warned slam, then exposes its mechanism. Guard or break it before the press lands.

name: Titan Walker
flavor: Commander Rylos pilots this siege frame from a cockpit suspended over the volcano vent.
description: Rylos pilots a single chassis with four destructible systems. Disable the system preparing an attack to cancel it, or drive straight for the chassis. Strike while the vents are exposed.

name: Compliance Fighter
flavor: A remote interceptor slaved to Orbital Compliance.
description: Marks its missile pass before committing, then reorients. Shock disrupts its guidance.

windups.ring_guided_pass: Guidance light fixing a missile pass

name: Compliance Officer
flavor: A security officer who now answers to Vale instead of Thorne.
description: Commits to a warned detention sweep, then resets its stance.

windups.ring_detain: Officer winding up a detention sweep

name: Null-G Drone
flavor: A maintenance unit re-tasked to pin intruders in zero gravity.
description: Prepares a short gravity tether, then releases its clamps. Shock is effective.

name: Void Turret
flavor: A tracking cannon bolted between frozen server racks.
description: Charges a beam before firing, then vents. Interrupt the charge or guard and punish the opening.

name: Hunter-Killer Droid
flavor: An unstoppable pursuit chassis that rebuilds itself faster than conventional damage can accumulate.
description: Pursuit threat. Stasis is the intended counter.

name: Elite Guard
flavor: Vale's inner guard carries a reflector shield tuned against ranged energy.
description: Mirror Guard returns half the damage of single-target focus-scaled energy skills and energy firearm shots, capped at a quarter of the attacker’s maximum HP. Physical, melee and area attacks do not reflect. Its shield drops for a warned strike and recovery.

windups.ring_guard_strike: Mirror shield lowering for a strike

name: Firewall Construct
flavor: An angular hard-light lattice that declares each defensive frequency before committing to it.
description: Announces Amber (Burn weakness, Shock resistance) and Blue (Shock weakness, Burn resistance) before changing frequency. Scan identifies the current opening. Physical and Source damage remain neutral; strike after its warned sweep.

name: Compliance Avatar
flavor: Orbital Compliance given a body: turrets, purge routines, and Vale's certainty rendered as hard light.
description: The Conductor directs joint attacks. Interrupt its preparation or destroy it to break coordination permanently. The Avatar recalibrates after the link breaks; defeating the body ends the encounter.

name: The Manager
flavor: A performance review large enough to blot out the horizon.
description: Zeke nightmare elite. Break its control loop.

name: War Echo
flavor: A target produced by Gh0st's kill-suite before conscience can object.
description: Fast nightmare striker vulnerable to Stasis.

name: Silent Shore
flavor: The conviction that Orion is the last voice left in creation.
description: Orion nightmare controller. Disruption breaks its silence.

name: Source Shadow
flavor: A hostile outline assembled from discarded versions of familiar enemies.
description: Basic Source distortion with unstable defenses.

name: Warped Sentinel
flavor: A Spire sentinel folded through angles its chassis was never built to occupy.
description: Turn-order controller vulnerable to shock and hacking.

name: Glitch Hound
flavor: A Wilds predator flickering between the place it attacks from and the place it remembers.
description: High-evasion striker exposed by Scan.

name: Memory Leak
flavor: A pulsing data mass leaking unfinished images of Jed, Thorne, and Elara.
description: Debuff elite requiring focus fire.

name: Nightmare Guard
flavor: A Dominion guard wearing the faces of everyone Nova believes she failed.
description: Shielded guilt projection vulnerable to melee pressure.

name: The Ascended: Soloist
flavor: Vale retains his human shape because politeness makes annihilation easier to accept.
description: Vale announces a targeted Silence command or verdict. Guard the marked ally and strike during recovery.

name: The Ascended: Silence
flavor: Porcelain skin splits into blinding geometry as Vale attempts to reduce creation to one painless note.
description: The Voice and Memory Anchors supply separate commands on one schedule. Destroy either to stop its attack. Guard the Great Silence and strike during the exposed opening.

name: Crucible Champion
flavor: A battle-scarred heavy loader reinforced with multilayered crucible alloy plating, undefeated in Brutus's arena.
description: A light checking jab precedes a warned hammer strike. Use the exposed recovery. White Heat shortens its recovery below 35% HP. Its prize includes one Pure Iron.

name: Moss Borer
flavor: A broad cavern grazer carries moss along its mineral plates. The plates close before a cloudy exhalation, then open while it draws breath.
description: Closes its moss carapace, warns of a mineral exhale, then opens to recover. Cavern pairs start at different points in this rhythm.

name: Mist Glider
flavor: A reed-finned glider hangs over the still pools. A silver membrane gathers around its fins before it folds into a resonant dive.
description: Gathers a short-lived mist membrane before a marked dive. Guard or interrupt the dive; attack while it recovers.

name: Concierge Relay
flavor: Broadcasts one interruptible shield order, then repositions.
description: Broadcasts one interruptible shield order, then repositions.

name: Interdictor Drone
flavor: Deploys from the Administrator and prepares one interception pulse.
description: Deploys from the Administrator and prepares one interception pulse.

name: Missile Battery
description: Opens its pods before a salvo aimed at the whole crew.

name: Cutting Arm
description: Extends its cutter for a heavy strike on a single crew member.

name: Anchor Cannon
description: Locks onto a single crew member before a disruptive shot.

name: Shield Projector
description: Briefly protects the chassis when its pulse fires.

name: Directive Conductor
flavor: A separate command intelligence conducting the Avatar through a fragile hard-light link.
description: Independent command partner. Supplies three brief wards, never direct attacks. Its destruction permanently breaks the Avatar link.

name: Boardroom Bailiff
flavor: The abandoned boardroom still enforces votes cast by dead directors.
description: Optional judgment elite. Raises a limited guard before committing to a warned verdict. Its defeat grants no Avatar story credit.

name: Customs Screener
flavor: Marks one crew member for squad pressure, then resets. Interrupt its scanner preparation.
description: Marks one crew member for squad pressure, then resets. Interrupt its scanner preparation.

windups.ring_designate: Scanner paddles narrowing to one crew member

name: Tether Rigger
flavor: An interruptible cable reduces a target’s damage briefly, followed by two recovery turns.
description: An interruptible cable reduces a target’s damage briefly, followed by two recovery turns.

name: Prism Surveyor
flavor: Prepares three brief squad damage boosts. Interrupt the alignment or remove the supported attacker.
description: Prepares three brief squad damage boosts. Interrupt the alignment or remove the supported attacker.

name: Threshold Remnant
flavor: Warns before an incomplete fracture, then unravels into exposed recovery.
description: Warns before an incomplete fracture, then unravels into exposed recovery.

name: Review Clerk
flavor: A performance review large enough to blot out the horizon.
description: Its stamp marks one target for a follow-up. Interrupt the stamp or defend the marked ally.

name: War Order Fragment
flavor: A target produced by Gh0st's kill-suite before conscience can object.
description: Charges a single shot, then drifts apart into exposed recovery.

name: Tide Murmur
flavor: The conviction that Orion is the last voice left in creation.
description: A low tide briefly weakens one ally. Interrupt the gathering wave.

name: Voice Anchor
flavor: Supplies the targeted Silence command. Destroy it to cancel its preparation.
description: Supplies the targeted Silence command. Destroy it to cancel its preparation.

name: Memory Anchor
flavor: Supplies the party-wide memory pulse. Destroy it to cancel its preparation.
description: Supplies the party-wide memory pulse. Destroy it to cancel its preparation.

name: Quench Mite
flavor: Its coolant sac swells before a cold vent. Damage interrupts the swelling.
description: Its coolant sac swells before a cold vent. Damage interrupts the swelling.

name: Magnet Sifter
flavor: Marks one crew member so its partner can aim a committed attack at them.
description: Marks one crew member so its partner can aim a committed attack at them.
